The close-out gate must read the review directory recorded in the task's run.json, not only REVIEW.md.

**Why:** A PR-mode review persists outside task state by design, so a task reviewed that way refused
`--mark-done` with `review verdict is ?` even though its work was finished.

**How to apply:** When a gate reads a task artifact, check whether the producer records its location
and resolve through that record.

**Don't apply when:** The artifact is written by the gate's own write path in every mode.
